Indonesian President Names Vice President Candidates to Parliament

Indonesian President Joko Widodo has submitted the names of two vice presidential candidates to parliament. The candidates are intended to replace Gibran Rakabuming Raka, who is currently running for president. The specific names of the candidates were not disclosed in the provided coverage.
